Great question! Argus doesn’t have a built-in stock screener or discovery tool to help you find new stocks to invest in. Instead, Argus is designed to help you **run experiments** on assets that you already have in mind.

Here’s what that means in practice:

- You bring the asset (like a specific stock, crypto, or currency pair) that you’re curious about.
- Argus checks if it’s in our shared provider-backed catalog. If it is, you can set up a backtest to see how a strategy would have performed over a specific time window.
- If the asset exists but the time window you want isn’t available, Argus will ask you for a runnable window instead of pretending it can run.

So while Argus can’t find new stocks for you, it can help you test ideas on stocks you already have on your radar. If you’re looking for stock discovery, you might pair Argus with a separate screening tool, then bring your candidates here to experiment.
